name: firewall-map-renderer
description: Builds src/opnsense/www/js/firewall-map-renderer.js (src/, vite.config.js) and firewall-map-page.js (page/, vite.page.config.js). Place this directory at examples/vite-app inside a checkout of https://github.com/visgl/flowmap.gl (v9.4.0), run pnpm install there, then npm run build and copy dist-firewall-map/firewall-map-renderer.js and dist-firewall-map-page/firewall-map-page.js into the plugin.
